body: Tylil James revealed messages he sent to Reggie on September 27th, showing him love and offering words of encouragement after Reggie posted his first “exposing Clover Boys” video. Instead of letting everything remain about the controversy, Tylil appeared to reach out with a different perspective, expressing support with two simple but powerful messages: “I love you bro” and “Hold your head high. ” 🏽 Did Reggie take things to far? kaicenat.
